# dimmi

> dimmi is an open-source (MIT) customer support platform with a shared inbox, AI support agents, procedures, Operator, tickets, workflows, and a help center. This file tells coding assistants how to add the dimmi messenger to an app, call the REST API, or connect over MCP on a dimmi server.

You need two values from the dimmi dashboard: the messenger app id (`wgt_...`, Settings > Messengers) and the dimmi host (the cloud address `https://trydimmi.com` or your self-hosted URL). The messenger loader script is `<host>/widget/v1/loader.js`.

## MCP server

Connect an MCP client to `<host>/mcp` (Streamable HTTP transport, OAuth 2.0 or `Authorization: Bearer <api_token>`) to search knowledge, manage conversations, contacts, tickets, help articles, and procedures, or propose reviewable Operator edits.

- OAuth discovery metadata: `<host>/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`
- MCP guide: https://trydimmi.com/docs/developers/mcp.md
- Server card (dimmi Cloud): https://trydimmi.com/docs/mcp/server-card.json

## Pick the messenger package

- Plain HTML or any other stack: paste `<script async src="<host>/widget/v1/loader.js" data-app-id="wgt_..."></script>` before `</body>`, or use `@dimmi/browser`.
- React 18+ (Vite, CRA, Remix, React Router): `npm i @dimmi/react`; wrap the app in `<DimmiProvider appId host identity>`; use `useDimmi()`.
- Next.js 14+ (App Router): `npm i @dimmi/nextjs`; add `dimmi.config.ts` with `defineDimmi({ identify })`, a server action returning `identityToken(config)` from `@dimmi/nextjs/server`, and `<DimmiProvider identity={action}>` in `app/layout.tsx`.
- Vue 3: `npm i @dimmi/vue`; `app.use(createDimmi({ appId, host }))`; `useDimmi()` in components.
- Nuxt 3: `npm i @dimmi/vue`; register `createDimmi` in `plugins/dimmi.client.ts` (client-only).
- Angular 17+: `npm i @dimmi/angular`; `provideDimmi({ appId, host })` in `app.config.ts`; inject `DimmiService`.
- Svelte / SvelteKit: `npm i @dimmi/svelte`; `initDimmi({ appId, host })` in the root layout's `onMount`; `use:dimmiAction`.

## Pick the backend SDK

- TypeScript / Node.js 20+: `npm i @dimmi/api`; `createDimmiApi({ host, token, workspace })`; `api.GET("/contacts")`; `paginate(api, "/contacts")`.
- Node.js identity tokens: `npm i @dimmi/server` (`signIdentityToken`, `createIdentityHandler`, `@dimmi/server/express`, `@dimmi/server/hono`).
- Go 1.22+: `go get github.com/dimmihq/dimmi-go` (REST client, identity tokens, webhook verification).
- PHP 8.2+: `composer require dimmi/dimmi-php` (Guzzle REST client, identity tokens, webhook verification).
- Laravel 10-12: `composer require dimmi/dimmi-laravel` (`Dimmi::` facade, `@dimmiMessenger`, webhook routes & events).
- Python 3.10+: `pip install dimmi-sdk` (`import dimmi`; httpx REST client, identity tokens, webhook verification).

## Identity verification

Never trust a user id from the browser. Sign a short-lived JWT on your server and hand the browser only the token:

- Env: `DIMMI_IDENTITY_SECRET` (optional `DIMMI_IDENTITY_KID` for HS256; required with `DIMMI_IDENTITY_PRIVATE_KEY` for RS256/ES256/EdDSA) from Settings > Identity verification.
- Browser: pass `identity: async () => tokenOrNull`, or `identityUrl: "/api/dimmi/token"` answering `{"token": "<jwt>"}` or `{"token": null}`.
- After sign-in without a reload call `identify()`; on sign-out call `shutdown()`.

## Messenger API (every browser package)

`show()`, `hide()`, `toggle()`, `showNewMessage(text?)`, `update({ appearance: { position, primary_color, theme, launcher } })`, `identify(fn?)`, `shutdown()`, `onUnreadCountChange(fn)`, `trackEvent(name, metadata)` (only names switched on for the messenger in Settings > Attributes are recorded; record events a rule must trust server-side with `POST /api/v1/contact-events`). Options: `appId`, `host`, `apiBase` (proxy), `nonce` (CSP with `'strict-dynamic'`), `identity`, `identityUrl`, `settings`.

## REST API

- Base URL: `<host>/api/v1`; OpenAPI 3.1 contract at `<host>/api/v1/openapi.json`.
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`; workspace: `Dimmi-Workspace: <workspace id>`.
- Lists: `cursor` + `limit` (`meta.next_cursor`); a few page by `offset`. `429` answers carry `Retry-After`. POSTs accept `Idempotency-Key`.
